visual_instruction: One traditional Bronze floor lamp. Show a complete supported base, long upright stem and properly attached shade. Keep the shade, stem and base coherent and on the same vertical axis.
purpose: Test a complete tall lamp assembly.

visual_instruction: One traditional Bronze table lamp. Show a complete supported base, short upright stem and properly attached shade. Keep the shade, stem and base coherent and on the same vertical axis.
purpose: Test a complete short lamp assembly, to be reused only after acceptance.

visual_instruction: One dinner fork with a coherent fork head, clearly separated tines and continuous handle. Lay the utensil flat with its head pointing up and handle pointing down.
purpose: Test a single place-setting utensil before attempting the remaining flatware types.

visual_instruction: One cake server with a broad triangular serving blade and continuous handle. Lay the utensil flat with its blade pointing up and handle pointing down. No cake or food.
purpose: Test a distinct serving utensil shape.
